{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import qualified Network.WebSockets as WS
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.IO as TIO
import Data.Text (Text)
import System.Process (readProcessWithExitCode)
import System.Exit (ExitCode(..))
import Control.Exception (catch, SomeException)
import Control.Monad (forever, when)
import Data.Char (isAlphaNum, isSpace)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)

-- Kubernetes health check and pod management WebSocket server
-- Handles namespace-scoped queries for pod status

type SessionMap = Map.Map Text Text

data ServerState = ServerState
  { activeSessions :: IORef SessionMap
  , clusterName   :: Text
  }

-- Allowed characters for namespace identifiers per K8s spec
-- RFC 1123: lowercase alphanumeric, hyphens, max 63 chars
validateNamespace :: Text -> Bool
validateNamespace ns =
  let s = T.unpack ns
      validChar c = isAlphaNum c || c == '-'
  in not (T.null ns)
     && T.length ns <= 63
     && all validChar s
     && head s /= '-'
     && last s /= '-'

-- Sanitize label selector values
-- K8s label values: [a-z0-9A-Z] with [-_.] allowed internally
sanitizeLabelValue :: Text -> Text
sanitizeLabelValue = T.filter (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c `elem` ['-', '_', '.'])

-- Reject any value that could enable path traversal via '..' segments.
-- This is a distinct check from shell-metacharacter sanitization.
hasDotDot :: Text -> Bool
hasDotDot t = ".." `T.isInfixOf` t

-- Build kubectl command arguments safely
buildKubectlArgs :: Text -> Text -> [String]
buildKubectlArgs namespace labelSelector =
  [ "get", "pods"
  , "--namespace=" ++ T.unpack namespace
  , "-l", T.unpack labelSelector
  , "-o", "json"
  , "--request-timeout=5s"
  ]

-- Execute kubectl with validated parameters
execKubectl :: Text -> Text -> IO (Either Text Text)
execKubectl namespace labelSelector = do
  let args = buildKubectlArgs namespace labelSelector
  (exitCode, stdout, stderr) <- readProcessWithExitCode "kubectl" args ""
  case exitCode of
    ExitSuccess -> return $ Right (T.pack stdout)
    _           -> return $ Left (T.pack stderr)

-- Parse incoming WebSocket message protocol
-- Format: "CMD|namespace|label_selector|options"
parseMessage :: Text -> Maybe (Text, Text, Text, Text)
parseMessage msg =
  case T.splitOn "|" msg of
    [cmd, ns, label, opts] -> Just (cmd, ns, label, opts)
    _ -> Nothing

-- Process diagnostic commands using direct file reads
-- Safely constructs path without shell interpretation
processDiagnostic :: Text -> Text -> IO Text
processDiagnostic namespace podPattern = do
  let safeNs = T.filter (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '-') namespace
  let safePod = T.filter (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '-' || c == '.') podPattern
  -- Reject path-traversal sequences before building the path (CWE-22 guard).
  if hasDotDot safeNs || hasDotDot safePod
    then return "No logs available"
    else do
      -- Use find + xargs with no shell interpretation to avoid injection
      let basePath = "/var/log/pods/" ++ T.unpack safeNs ++ "/" ++ T.unpack safePod
      (exitCode, stdout, _) <- readProcessWithExitCode "find" [basePath, "-name", "*.log", "-type", "f", "-exec", "tail", "-n", "100", "{}", ";"] ""
      case exitCode of
        ExitSuccess -> return $ T.pack stdout
        _           -> return "No logs available"

-- Handle individual WebSocket connection
handleConnection :: ServerState -> WS.Connection -> IO ()
handleConnection state conn = do
  WS.sendTextData conn ("Connected to cluster: " <> clusterName state :: Text)
  forever $ do
    msg <- WS.receiveData conn :: IO Text
    response <- processRequest state msg
    WS.sendTextData conn response

processRequest :: ServerState -> Text -> IO Text
processRequest state msg = do
  case parseMessage msg of
    Nothing -> return "ERROR|Invalid message format. Use: CMD|namespace|label|options"
    Just (cmd, ns, label, opts) -> do
      case cmd of
        "PODS" -> do
          if validateNamespace ns
            then do
              let cleanLabel = sanitizeLabelValue label
              result <- execKubectl ns cleanLabel
              case result of
                Right json -> return $ "OK|" <> json
                Left err   -> return $ "ERROR|" <> err
            else return "ERROR|Invalid namespace format"
        "DIAG" -> do
          if validateNamespace ns
            then do
              result <- processDiagnostic ns label
              return $ "OK|" <> result
            else return "ERROR|Invalid namespace format"
        "HEALTH" -> return "OK|healthy"
        _ -> return "ERROR|Unknown command"

main :: IO ()
main = do
  sessions <- newIORef Map.empty
  cluster <- maybe "default" T.pack <$> lookupEnv "CLUSTER_NAME"
  let state = ServerState sessions cluster
  putStrLn "Starting K8s WebSocket server on port 9160"
  WS.runServer "0.0.0.0" 9160 $ \pending -> do
    conn <- WS.acceptRequest pending
    WS.withPingThread conn 30 (return ()) $
      handleConnection state conn
        `catch` (\e -> TIO.putStrLn $ "Connection error: " <> T.pack (show (e :: SomeException)))
